description.zh: API请求因无权限被拒绝访问时，从响应体 `AccessDeniedDetail.EncodedDiagnosticMessage`字段中获取的编码诊断信息。该参数用于解码无权限诊断信息，调用本接口时需传入。
description.en: The encoded diagnostic message obtained from the `AccessDeniedDetail.EncodedDiagnosticMessage` field in the response body when an API request is denied due to insufficient permissions. Pass this parameter to decode the permission diagnostic information when calling this operation.
